sanjay: launching config-only change now — reduce max_batch to 40, timeout 1100ms -> 900ms, routing policy tweak to prefer dedicated pool during peak.
leah: change window 21:30-22:30 PT, please scope canary to us-west-2 and non-enterprise tenants.
deploy-bot: rollout start: stage=canary pct=1 region=us-west-2 tenant_cohort=non-enterprise config=cfg/2026-03-21/tight-batching.json
sanjay: model pinned to v2.3.1 for this rollout. no binaries.
owen: add auto-rollback: errors > 0.4% OR p99 > baseline*1.4 sustained 4m. link runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/config-rollbacks
sanjay: done — rollback rule set and pager attached to #eng-oncall.
observability-bot: initial canary metrics -> p50=110ms p95=290ms p99=540ms errors=0.03% cost_delta=-0.6%
leah: p99 is slightly higher than baseline 500ms but within threshold. continue.
sanjay: will proceed to 5% in 8m if stable. publishing short release note: "Config-only: tighten request timeout to 900ms, reduce max_batch_size to 40, bias routing to dedicated during peak. Scoped canary to us-west-2 non-enterprise cohort. Auto-rollback on error/p99 regressions."
owen: thumbs up. keep kv-cache watch; if kv_miss_rate rises, we'll pause.
deploy-bot: canary healthy at 1% after 10m. advancing to 5%.
observability-bot: alerting enabled, dashboards pinned.
sanjay: will report final after full rollout or immediate status if rollback triggers.
